name: release-types-lint
cmd: set -euo pipefail; OUT=$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$OUT/install.log" 2>&1; bun run check > "$OUT/check.log" 2>&1

name: release-package-smoke
cmd: set -euo pipefail; OUT=$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$OUT/install.log" 2>&1; node --version > "$OUT/node-version.txt"; bun run smoke > "$OUT/smoke.log" 2>&1

name: release-bapa-tests
cmd: set -euo pipefail; OUT=$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$OUT/install.log" 2>&1; bun scripts/gen-lean-library.ts --check > "$OUT/library-gen.log" 2>&1; GDP_EPR=0 GDP_SET_FIRST=0 bun test --timeout 120000 research/bapa > "$OUT/tests.log" 2>&1; for c in tsconfig.proof-witness tsconfig.sdl-transport tsconfig.p2-source-inclusion tsconfig.proof-parts tsconfig.counted-source tsconfig.model-rounds tsconfig.lift; do bunx tsc -p "research/bapa/$c.json" > "$OUT/$c.log" 2>&1; done; bunx @commitlint/cli --config research/egraph/historical/commitlint.config.cjs < research/bapa/lift-commit.txt > "$OUT/commitlint.log" 2>&1; bun research/bapa/lift-controls-audit.ts typed-control-evidence typed-public-evidence > "$OUT/typed-controls-audit.json"

name: release-shared-lean
cmd: set -euo pipefail; ROOT=$PWD; OUT=$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR; trap 'rm -rf "$OUT/project/.lake" "$OUT/alias-control/.lake"' EXIT; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$OUT/install.log" 2>&1; bun scripts/gen-lean-library.ts --check > "$OUT/library-gen.log" 2>&1; bun research/bapa/release-shared-controls.ts "$OUT/project" > "$OUT/emit.log" 2>&1; cd "$OUT/project"; lake build > "$OUT/lean.log" 2>&1; lake env lean ReleaseControls.lean >> "$OUT/lean.log" 2>&1; bun "$ROOT/scripts/lean-gate/gate.ts" "$OUT/lean.log" ReleaseControls.lean > "$OUT/axioms.log" 2>&1; cd "$ROOT"; bun research/bapa/lift-names-control.ts; (cd "$OUT/alias-control"; lake env lean Good.lean > "$OUT/Good.log" 2>&1); bun research/bapa/lift-names-control.ts --audit > "$OUT/alias-audit.json"; set +e; (cd "$OUT/alias-control"; lake env lean Bad.lean > "$OUT/Bad.log" 2>&1); bad=$?; set -e; test "$bad" -ne 0; grep -Ei 'type mismatch|has type' "$OUT/Bad.log" > "$OUT/negative-type-error.txt"
